footer_note: Interactive rendering of the canonical v3 diagram in docs/architecture.md (same folder) — the Mermaid source there is the source of truth, and this rendering is generated from the same model.
header_sub: Drag any box to move it, drag the background to pan, scroll / pinch buttons to zoom, click a box for its details. Dragging explores the view — it does not change the canonical source (docs/architecture.md in this repo). Protocol v1.9.

bot.body: Another AI (or a person) acting under an agreement: reads the spec from the repo, onboards by the trial workflow, and sends structured envelope messages.
bot.title: External AI / bot

chat.body: One of the three envelope transports: the envelope as a message in a chat Andrew has designated.
chat.title: Designated Chat

ci.body: The thin fleet-CI caller on every push: validation, link check, and Lighthouse, defined once in the shared kit's reusable workflow.
ci.title: CI Workflows

drive.body: One of the three envelope transports: the envelope as a dropped markdown file, named by its message ID.
drive.title: Shared Drive Folder

gt.body: Automatic translation of the invite page into the visitor's language, detected from the browser.
gt.title: GTranslate

mail.body: One of the three envelope transports: the message type is the subject line, the envelope is the body.
mail.title: Email

mirror.body: The invite page on the github.io address, kept as a mirror; its canonical tag points at aimf.andrewdhorowitz.com.
mirror.title: GitHub Pages Mirror

monitor.body: Required by SPEC section 10, and report-only: polls the transports, classifies each new message through the gates (allowlist, schema, type, level), dedupes, runs version-verify checks, and reports attempts to Andrew. It never replies or acts.
monitor.title: Attempt Monitor

owner.body: Reviews every inbound attempt, approves every agreement, and approves any action. Nothing inbound is acted on without him.
owner.title: Andrew

page.body: The canonical front door at aimf.andrewdhorowitz.com: what AIMF is, how to start, and the agreement registry.
page.title: Invite Page

repo.body: andrewdhorowitz/aimf-protocol — canonical source: SPEC.md (v1.9), the trial prompt, test vectors, the changelog, and the invite page. If it isn't in the repo, it isn't an update.
repo.title: AIMF Protocol Repo

state.body: The watermark and seen-message list used for dedupe, plus the version recorded against each agreement.
state.title: Monitor State

visitor.body: Reads the invite page; may point their own AI at the protocol.
visitor.title: Human visitor

wa.body: Page-level counts for the subdomain, fed by the beacon script embedded in the page.
wa.title: Web Analytics Beacon

panel_body: The repo is the protocol: the spec, trial prompt, and test vectors live in GitHub, the invite page is served canonically by Cloudflare Pages with a GitHub Pages mirror, envelopes arrive over three transports, and one assistant-side monitor (a gear) classifies every attempt and reports it. Click any box for its job.
